title: Rory O'S'mores
author: Moose Flores
problems: The progression after row 8 "neighbors balance & pull by right · pull by" doesn't work out: Couples 1 and 2 have not passed each other yet.
Row 1 "star left 4 places" can't start from where the dancers are: A star of 4 needs the dancers spaced around a ring.
Row 2 "star right 3 places" can't start from where the dancers are: A star of 4 needs the dancers spaced around a ring.
choices: Rory O'More spins one full turn in the travel direction.
The balance before each Rory steps toward the slide direction first.
A star with no grip named is a basket star (wrist grip).
A meltdown swing starts with 4 beats of right-shoulder round, then swings.
